subject: plotTangentSpace point color and GPA mean shape plot

messages.author: d4ffa34f04bcd8a8
messages.subject: plotTangentSpace point color and GPA mean shape plot
parts:
Hello Geomorphers,

I am working on a group of morphologically conserved (and very round) water mites. One of my goals is to objectively identify which characters are most useful for discriminating between morphologically similar species. My dataset includes 19 species, and I'm finding that plotTangentSpace reuses the same colors when more than 8 groups (in my case, species) are defined. I already have a color palette I've used for the same species with other analyses. Is there a way to carry the color palette over to the PCA plot from plotTangentSpace?

I'm also looking into using the mean shape produced by the GPA to indicate which landmarks/semilandmarks are most useful in distinguishing between species (based on results of an LDA  after GPA). From what I can tell, the LDA conflicts with the warp grid function, resulting in the amusing "crumpled napkin" grids in the attached plot. Instead of pursuing that issue, I'm interested if it would be possible to plot the mean shape with certain landmarks plotted in a different color to highlight which landmarks/semilandmarks are informative. My idea right now is to plot the full mean shape, then plot the informative sites in a different color (layering these plots in photoshop if necessary), but I'm curious if anybody else has experience with this.

Thank you!

Rachel Shoop
Evolutionary Biology Master's Candidate
San Diego State University
